pages.text: Training unlocked after reading the $(l:rumors/requiem_demolition_scroll)Demolition Scroll$(), devoted to projected firepower.
Artillerymen are gunners who man Supplementaries cannons. They load, aim, and fire on their own, drawing powder and shot from the ammo barrels you bind to them.
Grenadiers are heavy infantry who hurl bombs, keeping their distance from approaching foes — and drawing the $(l:crafts/requiem_pale_saber)Pale Saber$() when forced into melee.
Conquerors are crossbow-armed line infantry who loose fireworks as ammunition, blasting foes with dazzling bursts.
Artillery Captains command a gun squad. Bind one with the $(l:crafts/requiem_artillery_horn)Artillery Horn$() to set a battery and blow for a volley, and the squad's gunners answer to him.
